data.title: 塔露拉 · 温泉旅馆私人汤池微雾岩石畔的缠绵相依
data.description: 日式温泉度假旅馆的私人庭院木桶汤池内，水汽在竹影间袅袅升腾。塔露拉褪尽衣物半浸在温热的泉水中，双臂轻搭在桧木池沿上。水珠顺着微湿的银灰长发滑落光洁玉背，她回首望向身侧靠近的你，金瞳中泛着水雾与娇羞，龙尾在温水中轻轻缠上你的脚踝。
data.location: 日式温泉旅馆私人庭院露天木桶汤池边
data.action: 双臂搭在木桶池沿，湿身回眸，水雾缭绕中龙尾轻缠
data.lighting: 庭院石灯笼的暖黄烛光与温润水气反射
data.camera: cowboy shot, from behind, looking over shoulder
promptTokens: arms resting on wooden tub edge
data.promptProse: Resting her arms on the cedar rim of the private outdoor bath, gentle steam curls around her glistening silver hair. The warm glow of the stone garden lantern traces down her bare spine as she looks over her shoulder, her tail gently swirling through the hot spring water.
data.animaCaption: She rests her arms on the cedar onsen edge in the rising steam, looking back over her shoulder with flushed cheeks.
